Ever After Films — Wedding Cinematography, Mumbai

Ever After Films is a Mumbai-based wedding cinematography studio focused on
elegant, understated films with a strong emphasis on storytelling and sound
design. They typically take on a limited number of weddings each season to keep
quality high.

Their cinematography-only package (full crew, feature film plus highlight reel)
is ₹2,10,000. Photography can be bundled through partner studios on request.

Contact: +91 98201 76654 · hello@everafterfilms.example
Location: Bandra West, Mumbai, Maharashtra
Rating: 4.9 / 5 (76 reviews)

What couples say:
"The film felt like a real story, not just clips stitched together."
"Sound design and music choice were spot on."
"Professional, punctual, and a joy to work with."

Ever After prefers a pre-wedding call to understand the couple's story and plans
shots accordingly. Delivery is typically within eight weeks.
